# Visit Utah

> > Utah's official travel guide featuring The Mighty 5 national parks, world-class skiing, outdoor adventures, and curated regional experiences across the Beehive State.

Visit Utah is the state's comprehensive tourism resource offering detailed information on destinations, accommodations, activities, and travel planning. The site emphasizes Utah's iconic natural attractions—including five national parks (Zion, Arches, Canyonlands, Bryce Canyon, and Capitol Reef)—alongside winter sports, outdoor recreation, and regional guides.

## Key Topics

- The Mighty 5 National Parks
- Zion National Park
- Arches National Park
- Bryce Canyon National Park
- Canyonlands National Park
- Capitol Reef National Park
- Salt Lake City
- Park City
- Moab
- Outdoor Activities
- Hiking Trails
- Ski Resorts
- Camping
- Southern Utah
- Winter Travel

## Core Destinations & Parks

- [The Mighty 5](https://www.visitutah.com/Places-To-Go/Parks-Outdoors/The-Mighty-5): Guide to Utah's five iconic national parks with entry fees and reservations.
- [Utah National Parks & State Parks](https://www.visitutah.com/Places-To-Go/Parks-Outdoors): Comprehensive guide to Utah's national and state parks including The Mighty 5.
- [Places To Go In Utah](https://www.visitutah.com/Places-To-Go): Directory of Utah destinations including Arches, Antelope Island and Bear Lake.
- [Visiting Southern Utah](https://www.visitutah.com/Visiting-Southern-Utah): Regional guide to Southern Utah parks including Moab, Arches and Canyonlands.
- [Northern Utah](https://www.visitutah.com/Places-To-Go/Northern): Regional guide to Northern Utah including Salt Lake City, Park City and Ogden.

## Cities & Towns

- [Utah Cities & Towns](https://www.visitutah.com/Places-To-Go/Cities-and-Towns): Directory of Utah cities and towns including Salt Lake City, Park City and Moab.
- [Urban Experiences & Activities](https://www.visitutah.com/Places-To-Go/Urban): Guide to urban activities in Wasatch Front cities including Park City and Davis.

## Outdoor Activities & Adventures

- [Things To Do](https://www.visitutah.com/things-to-do): Main directory of Utah activities including hiking, skiing, camping and water sports.
- [Hiking](https://www.visitutah.com/things-to-do/Hiking): Hiking guide with trails in national parks including Arches and Bryce Canyon.
- [Camping In Utah](https://www.visitutah.com/things-to-do/Camping): Camping guide covering campgrounds near national parks and state parks.
- [River Rafting in Utah](https://www.visitutah.com/things-to-do/River-Rafting): Guide to rafting and kayaking on Colorado, Green and San Juan rivers.

## Winter Sports & Snow Activities

- [Utah Ski Resorts](https://www.visitutah.com/Places-To-Go/Utah-Ski-Resorts): Directory of 15 Utah ski resorts with season updates, snow reports and itineraries.
- [Utah Skiing](https://www.visitutah.com/things-to-do/skiing): Skiing guide covering 15 resorts, ski towns and The Greatest Snow on Earth.
- [Snowboarding In Utah](https://www.visitutah.com/things-to-do/snowboarding): Snowboarding guide for Park City Mountain Resort and Utah ski destinations.
- [Utah Snowmobiling Trails, Tours & Rentals](https://www.visitutah.com/things-to-do/Snowmobiling): Guide to 800+ miles of groomed snowmobiling trails in Northern Utah.
- [Winter in Southern Utah](https://www.visitutah.com/Places-To-Go/Winter-Southern-Utah): Seasonal guide to winter hiking and snow activities in Southern Utah parks.

## Specialty Experiences

- [Dark Sky Parks & Places](https://www.visitutah.com/Places-To-Go/Dark-Sky-Parks): Guide to Utah's Dark-Sky certified parks for stargazing and astrophotography.

## Travel Planning & Resources

- [Utah Travel Guides & Official State Info](https://www.visitutah.com/plan-your-trip/Utah-Travel-Guide): Free downloadable travel guides with itineraries, scenic drives and bucket lists.
- [Visit Utah Homepage](https://www.visitutah.com): Official Visit Utah homepage with hotels, restaurants, events and attractions.
- [Newsletter Signup](https://www.visitutah.com/newsletter-signup): Email newsletter signup for Utah travel tips and The Mighty Five updates.
